card.name: Decimal point in section cross-references
card.fires_on: The period inside a numbered section reference in parentheses, such as (2.1) or (5.11), in the highlights summary of a drug label. It fires most on the point after the chapter number, mainly 2 for dosage and administration.

modes.label: Dosing section refs
modes.description: The point after 2 in a reference to the Dosage and Administration section, placed after a dosing instruction.

modes.label: Other section refs
modes.description: The point after another chapter number, such as 5 or 7, in a list of cross-references.
modes.example: Use with caution in combination with other drugs that prolong the QT interval (4.2, 5.11, 7<<.>>6, 7.7)
